description: What the user is working on now — the thing shown by the view of that sort last in front on the stage (3.1) — as a kind, an id, a title and the view that shows it, or null when nothing is open.

chapter.description: Which chapter of the subject is open, named as a link names it: the day as YYYY-MM-DD for the Journal, the chapter's title in lowercase letters, digits and hyphens for a book. Absent when the subject has no chapters or none is known yet.

chapterTitle.description: The open chapter's title as the book gives it, for display; present exactly when chapter is.
